title: Staying Healthy and Happy
article_en: Everyone has different ways to stay healthy. I think it is important to exercise every day. When you exercise, your body becomes strong and healthy. For example, you can run or play sports. This makes your heart beat faster. You also need enough sleep at night. A beautiful morning starts with good rest. Doing different things helps you grow up well.
article_zh: 每个人都有不同的保持健康的方式。我认为每天锻炼很重要。当你锻炼时，你的身体会变得强壮和健康。例如，你可以跑步或做运动。这会让你的心跳加速。你晚上还需要充足的睡眠。美丽的早晨从良好的休息开始。做不同的事情能帮助你健康成长。

grammar_points.name: 一般现在时
grammar_points.explanation: 描述经常发生的动作或普遍真理，如 'You need enough sleep.'
grammar_points.example: Everyone has different ways to stay healthy.

grammar_points.name: 形容词作表语
grammar_points.explanation: 使用be动词加形容词描述主语状态，如 'your body becomes strong'.
grammar_points.example: When you exercise, your body becomes strong.

grammar_points.name: 宾语从句
grammar_points.explanation: 动词后接句子作宾语，如 'think' 后面的内容。
grammar_points.example: I think it is important to exercise.

sentence_patterns.example: I think it is important to exercise every day.

sentence_patterns.pattern: It is + adj. + to do sth.
sentence_patterns.example: I think it is important to exercise every day.
For example, you can run or play sports.

knowledge_structure.title: 文章观点
knowledge_structure.content: 作者认为每天锻炼对保持健康很重要。

knowledge_structure.title: 论证理由
knowledge_structure.content: 锻炼能让身体强壮，需要足够的睡眠。

knowledge_structure.title: 文章结论
knowledge_structure.content: 做不同的事情有助于健康成长。
